title: MemberService.register
description: Parses the name and email, refuses a taken email and inserts the member, in one transaction.

title: ToolService.add
description: Parses the name, trims the description and inserts the tool in good condition.

title: ToolService.reportDamage
description: Parses the note and sets the tool to needs repair, leaving any loan alone.

title: ToolService.markRepaired
description: Refuses a tool that does not need repair, then sets it to good and clears the note.

title: LendingService.borrow
description: Runs the checks in order in one transaction and inserts the loan with its due date.

title: LendingService.return
description: Requires a valid condition, refuses a second return, records the return and reports whether it was late.
